notes.title: Achievements and more available
notes.content:
As promised, we've integrated achievements and cloud saves.

Also, we've done some minor graphical and performance improvements.

Working on leaderboards!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update coming soon!
notes.content:
We got a lot of feedback on the game, thank you all for your support! 

Some of you mentioned the need for cloud support and progress reset.

We always listen and an update will be live soon. It will also feature minor graphics and performance improvements.  

We'll keep you posted! Thank you again!

notes.title: It's official! We're launching on August 18th!
notes.content:
We're almost there and can't wait to hear your thoughts on our game as we’re counting on your constant feedback for future updates.
 
We’re always happy to hear you enjoy the Trials a lot, but we also know that it can be even better. So if you discover any problems or have any suggestions, please let us know, it will help us improve the game.
 
Thanks!
